name: suede-mcp-qa
description: Suede Labs AI MCP release QA, scoped to this pack's own server (mcp/suede-skills-mcp.mjs) and its catalog, install, and docs surface. Runs the full JSON-RPC lifecycle against a live server — initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get — plus protocol negotiation, closed input and output schemas, tool annotations, structuredContent with text fallbacks, malformed-input probes, clean stdio, catalog-to-folder agreemen
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 面向 MCP 服务发布的自动化质检工具，用于验证协议流程、接口规范及目录、安装与文档的一致性。
